note: BLM (Butte Field Office) recreation site on the Missouri River at Toston Dam, about 13 mi south of Townsend (1 mi south of Toston, turn east off US 287). Two camping areas: Upper Toston Dam just above the dam on the small reservoir (motorboats allowed), and Lower Toston Dam below it on the free-flowing river; covered picnic tables and grills; boat launches above and below the dam; rainbow and brown trout fishery. --Claude
summary: BLM page (and its recreation.gov info listing): confirmed no fees, BLM Butte Field Office management, phone 406-533-7600 and the two camping areas (Upper on the reservoir, Lower on the free-flowing river). The page no longer states site count, trailer length, stay limit, FCFS or facilities; those derived values are left. Note trimmed of restated values.
